title: Fresh coordinate of maximum influence
statement: Let $n\ge 2$, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $J\subseteq\{1,ldots,n\}$. Form a new function by setting every coordinate in $J$ to $1$ before evaluating $f$. If the fraction of inputs on which this new function equals $1$ is strictly between $0$ and $1$, then a coordinate of maximum influence of the new function lies outside $J$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$J$ is a finite set of coordinates
The positive bias after setting coordinates in $J$ to $1$ is greater than $0$
That positive bias is less than $1$
